projects.name: UBC VSA Social Media Identity
projects.meta: Vice President Graphic Design & Social Media · UBC Vietnamese Student Association · 2026 — present
projects.description: Social media graphics and brand visuals I designed for the UBC Vietnamese Student Association’s 2026–2027 year: club fair, recruitment, sponsorship and tier announcements.
projects.tags: Social media · Graphic design · Brand identity

projects.name: UV Webcam Particles
projects.thumb_alt: Glowing white particle trail from a TouchDesigner webcam experiment
projects.description: Experimenting with Touch Designer! This project is heavily inspired by @nyltiek. There's definitely a lot more tweaking to do. The file is linked if you want to try it out! Mess around with your nodes to change the particle design :>
projects.video_alt: Screen recording of the TouchDesigner project: a webcam feed with glowing white particles that follow a waving light

projects.name: Sports Photography
projects.thumb_alt: Two relay runners racing side by side on a track, batons in hand
projects.description: Action shots from school basketball, soccer and track events, captured from the sideline. I love chasing the split second a play comes together: the jump, the pivot, the ball just leaving a foot.
